title: Spandauer Damm, Berlin
description:
Fully renovated 110sqm (1184sqf) Altbau with modern kitchen, spacious 3 bedrooms, 2,5 bathrooms and fast wifi. Convenient bus stop at the door and a short walk to eateries and a supermarkets.

The space
This 1925-built classic Berlin "Altbau" apartment has high ceilings and original parquet floors thoughout. It has just been extensively renovated to create a brand new modern open plan feel inclusive of the  kitchen, living and dining space.  The apartment comes with two large size bathrooms and a separate guest toilet.  The laundry area includes a washing machine, dryer and storage space.
The apartment is 110m2 (1184sqf), located on the ground floor half way up.  there are 6 steps to climb at the building entrance.
The kitchen is fully equipped with all pots and pans, crockery and cutlery and other utensils, as well as a food processor, Nespresso machine, toaster, juicer, kettle, tea pot and baking dishes.  The kitchen also includes a gas stove, microwave, dishwasher and oven.  Fast wifi is installed (up to 500mbit).
Each of the three bedrooms have double windows and eternal shutters.  This helps minimise any noises from the street.  All bedrooms look over towards small garden plots.
Each bedroom has a flat-screen TV with cable channels.
The apartment is equipped with towels, bathmats and sheets, and pillows and duvets. 
The rear of the apartment looks over the private garden where one can enjoy the green space.  It is especially convenient if you have children.
Right out the front of the apartment is a bus stop (M45 Kirschenallee) that will have you in into the city centre (city west, Kurfürstendamm) in 25 minutes.
The closest supermarket (Edeka) is a short 10 minute walk away.

When you apply for this apartment, please send the following information;
1.  Please introduce yourself and explain why you need to rent the apartment for a fixed time.
2.  Advise how many people in total will stay (maximum 4).
3.  Advise if you will consider extending the stay.
4.  Advise if you are moving permanently to Berlin or just need the apartment for a fixed time.
5.  Send through a copy of your work contract, recent pay slip and proof you are able to pay the first months rent and bond.
6.  Advise whether you are on probation or not.
6.  If you can provide a copy of your Schufa, please send it through.

Once we are satisfied with your information we will send you confimation through the housing anywhere website, you are then required to pay the first months rent and then , separately pay the security bond into our bank account.  A rental contract will also be sent through for you to sign.

title: Suarezstraße, Berlin
description:
Fully furnished 3-room apartment on two levels located in an elegant building in the respectful area of Charlottenburg

The contempory modern living space has been designed and custom crafted by an italian architect and boasts a few details that give an innovative flair: imported floor tiles, wooden/iron stairs, design spotlights, an archway passage, a thick glass window in the bedroom, recurring grey details, and much more .

The very spacious and modern kitchen/living room is equipped with everything is needed for relaxing, cooking and eating: large sofa, glass table, american coffee machine, toaster, kettle, dishwasher, oven, fridge with refrigerator, cutlery, pots and pans and so on. The bathroom offers two useful cabinets, a modern shower at ground level, a top-loader washing machine. In the bedroom you find a double wardrobe (IKEA Pax), a comfortable double bed and a bed side table. The lower ground is a special quiet room where you can work and relax: there's a 5-door wardrobe, double bed with bed side table, large desk and a comfortable chair. Although located under ground, daylight comes in from 2 windows.

The neighbourhood is quiet and respectful, with many green areas, especially the elegant park with the lake LIETZEN SEE. Just around the corner you can find cafés, local shops and restaurants, as well as supermarkets at walking distance (EDEKA and LIDL).

The address Suarezstr. 44 is easily reachable by car via the city-highway and is well-served by public transportation. The closest station "Berlin Charlottenburg" offers both regional connections and local trains with the historic elevated central line leading to Zoologischer Garten, Hauptbahnhof, Alexander Platz, etc. In the nearby main street "Neue Kantstr." there are bus stops for the lines M. 
The internet connection with provider Vodafone is fast, reliable, flatrate and wireless.

The registration to the authorities is possible (Anmeldung). 
All costs are included in the monthly price, such as heating, water, electricity, internet, waste disposal, etc.

title: Witzlebenstraße, Berlin
description:
Welcome to your new home!

Our newly renovated 95 sqm flat on the top floor of an apartment building offers the perfect setting for cosy shared living. Thanks to the refurbishment, the entire flat shines in new splendour and impresses with modern comfort.

The centrepiece of the flat is the spacious and fully equipped communal kitchen. There is plenty of space here for cooking, eating and socialising together. The modern fitted kitchen has all the necessary appliances such as a hob, oven, fridge, dishwasher and plenty of storage space for all flatmates. This is where the best flat-share evenings are made!

The rooms themselves vary in size, so there is something to suit everyone. They can be rented furnished or unfurnished as required. The rooms are bright and friendly and offer enough space for privacy and personalisation. Due to the attic location, some rooms have a special charm with sloping ceilings and in some cases even a beautiful view.

In addition to the kitchen, there is a shared bathroom, which has also been modernised and is equipped with a shower or bathtub.

The entire flat has been designed with great attention to detail and offers a pleasant atmosphere. The bright rooms and modern furnishings create a feel-good ambience.

This property combines stylish living with a functional room layout and an urban lifestyle - a real highlight for anyone looking for something special.


AREA

We are located in the heart of Charlottenburg, right next to the picturesque Lietzensee Park. This unique combination of urban living and natural recreation is what makes living here so attractive.

The park itself is just a few steps from our front door and offers a welcome green oasis in the centre of the city. Here you can relax after work or at the weekend, go for a walk, jog, have a picnic or simply enjoy the peace and quiet by the water. The Lietzensee with its idyllic surroundings invites you to linger and offers a beautiful backdrop.

Despite the quiet location right next to the park, we are very well connected and benefit from Charlottenburg's excellent infrastructure. You will find everything you need for your daily needs in the immediate vicinity: Supermarkets, bakeries, pharmacies, doctors, banks and much more. The famous Kurfürstendamm shopping street with its numerous shops, boutiques and restaurants is also within easy reach.

Charlottenburg itself also offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. In addition to the Lietzensee Park, numerous cafés, restaurants and bars invite you to linger. Cultural institutions such as Charlottenburg Palace, the Deutsche Oper opera house and various theatres are also within easy reach.

And the best thing is: although we live so centrally and well connected, our flat is located in a quiet side street, so you won't be affected by any direct street noise. So here you can enjoy the benefits of urban life while living in a quiet and relaxed environment.

title: Spandauer Damm, Berlin
description:
Beautiful Historic Apartment with Palace View – A Peaceful, Inspiring Home for Professionals and Families in Berlin

This extraordinary apartment combines historic charm, generous space, and an unbeatable location—ideal for focused research, creative work, or family life in the city.

Located in a listed landmark building that once belonged to Charlottenburg Palace, the apartment features soaring 3.8-meter ceilings, original hardwood floors, intricate stucco details, and large windows with views of the palace and its gardens. A private green space, directly connected to the building, is home to birds and squirrels and includes a small playground, benches, and a barbecue area. Just around the corner, Klausenerplatz offers a large public playground and a lively neighborhood square.

Inside, the apartment offers:
	•	A spacious living room
	•	A large, sunlit study/home office
	•	Three bedrooms with double beds
	•	A fully equipped kitchen and all essentials for daily life
	•	Bicycles available for your use

The neighborhood is one of Berlin’s most charming and livable: international, authentic, and full of life. You’ll find countless cafés, restaurants, and bakeries—ranging from cozy local spots to global cuisine—just steps from your door. The River Spree is a five-minute walk away, and Berlin’s network of bike paths makes it easy to get anywhere in the city—or even to Potsdam, via a beautiful ride through the Grunewald forest. The S-Bahn and regional trains will also get you to Potsdam in under 20 minutes.

We lived here for many years as a family of five and even spent the entire COVID period here—comfortably and calmly, thanks to the beauty of the home and its surroundings.

Whether you’re here to teach, write, research, or simply experience Berlin at its best—this is a truly special place to call home.
